research_rationale:
EO 8497 (July 26, 1940, Franklin D. Roosevelt) is a one-paragraph exemption order read in full in the held American Presidency Project transcription (Common Crawl capture; a provisional working text, grade mirror_transcription). The page record's heading names the number and its date and subject agree with the text. Its only operative command, under section 204 of the act of June 30, 1932, exempts Maurice C. Latta from compulsory retirement for age for a stated term: "I hereby further exempt the said Maurice C. Latta from compulsory retirement for age for a period of one year ending October 31, 1941.". The term ends October 31, 1941 by its own words. Later exemption orders for the same person are later events and new grants; none revokes or shortens this order.
